variants.headline: Looking back: business plan abandoned before opening
variants.sub: The planned {business} will not open: {founder} has given up the plan.
variants.body:
We return to our earlier coverage. Our report recorded this: The founder {founder} had abandoned the plan for {business} before opening.

The company never opened. The plan has ended, but that is not the same as turning the clock back. The builder keeps the payment and any grant is owed back. Readers deserve that plain distinction before somebody makes giving up sound like a clean sheet with nothing left on it.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

The responsibility of {target} should be considered through the abandoned plan and its remaining obligations. The outcome is not an operating company's failure, but the end of a proposal before opening.
